name: material-dirty-gate-policy
title: Re-shape TEST and DONE blocking around dirty ownership categories
description: B-c9f5 dirty gate loops happened because the lifecycle gates treated every dirty path as a blocker. B-6326 (classifier), Story 2 (B-3506 / Koala metadata auto-commit), and B-cf60 (declared artifact) reshape the dirty surface, but blocking policy is still 'any dirty row blocks'. Move all gates to a single category-aware policy: material_source_changes, fixture_changes, and unexpected_dirty_files stay blocking; koala_metadata_changes, runtime_artifact_changes, and declared_artifact_changes pass with audit notation. Validate side-effect guard, TEST pre-check, and DONE gate must consume the same policy table so divergence cannot reappear.
